article.headline: D.J. Hall scores 18 as Texas State downs Texas A&M-Corpus Christi 67-55 in season opener
article.description: — D.J. Hall's 18 points helped Texas State defeat Texas A&M-Corpus Christi 67-55 on Monday night in a season opener.
article.linkText: D.J. Hall scores 18 as Texas State downs Texas A&M-Corpus Christi 67-55 in season opener

article.story: SAN MARCOS, Texas -- — D.J. Hall's 18 points helped Texas State defeat Texas A&M-Corpus Christi 67-55 on Monday night in a season opener. Hall also added five rebounds for the Bobcats. Robert Fields totaled 16 points and three steals. Desmond Kent Jr. led the way for the Islanders with 13 points. Daniel Michelini-Jackson had 10 points and CJ Worsham scored nine. Hall had seven points in the first half to help the Bobcats take a 35-26 lead at the break. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
